# two revisions of one role differ ONLY in key5, and both survive.
# identity is the key path, so the revision has to live inside it —
# in the value, revision 2 would collide with revision 1.
# key5 is zero-padded: a slot is TEXT, so "10" would sort before "2".
# padding makes ORDER BY key5 identical to numeric order. a caller
# never sees it — the contract carries an int64.
# key4 is a base-36 Snowflake, issued by the service. key6 is the
# name: a label, not a handle, and deliberately not unique.
revision column = 0 for every role. it is drift from the frozen 123
envelope — tenant | key1..key10 | value | ts | state — and is to be removed.
the roles table is folded away: tables 11 -> 10
